mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM t_inventory WHERE is_deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity * COALESCE(pc.avg_price, 0)), 0) FROM t_inventory i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT poi.material_id, SUM(COALESCE(poi.amount, poi.quantity * poi.unit_price)) / NULLIF(SUM(poi.quantity), 0) AS avg_price FROM t_purchase_order_item poi INNER JOIN t_purchase_order po ON poi.po_id = po.id WHERE po.is_deleted = 0 AND (po.status IS NULL OR po.status <> 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY poi.material_id ) pc ON i.material_id = pc.material_id WHERE i.is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT i.material_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(m.safety_stock) AS safety_stock FROM t_inventory i INNER JOIN t_material m ON i.material_id = m.id WHERE i.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.safety_stock IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.material_id HAVING SUM(i.quantity) < MAX(m.safety_stock) ) low_stock
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(defective_quantity), 0) FROM t_qc_inspection WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(defective_quantity), 0) FROM t_qc_inspection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND result = 'SCRAP'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(defective_quantity), 0) FROM t_qc_inspection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND result = 'REWORK'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS group_key, DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS group_name, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM t_purchase_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND order_date IS NOT NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status <> 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY group_key

SELECT CAST(po.supplier_id AS CHAR) AS group_key, COALESCE(s.supplier_name, CONCAT('Supplier-', po.supplier_id)) AS group_name, COALESCE(SUM(po.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM t_purchase_order po LEFT JOIN t_supplier s ON po.supplier_id = s.id WHERE po.is_deleted = 0 AND (po.status IS NULL OR po.status <> 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY po.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT CAST(poi.material_id AS CHAR) AS group_key, COALESCE(m.material_name, CONCAT('Material-', poi.material_id)) AS group_name, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(poi.amount, poi.quantity * poi.unit_price)), 0) AS amount FROM t_purchase_order_item poi INNER JOIN t_purchase_order po ON poi.po_id = po.id LEFT JOIN t_material m ON poi.material_id = m.id WHERE po.is_deleted = 0 AND (po.status IS NULL OR po.status <> 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY poi.material_id, m.material_name ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT months.month AS month, COALESCE(s.sales_income, 0) AS sales_income, COALESCE(p.purchase_expense, 0) AS purchase_expense, COALESCE(m.maintenance_expense, 0) AS maintenance_expense, COALESCE(s.sales_income, 0) - COALESCE(p.purchase_expense, 0) - COALESCE(m.maintenance_expense, 0) AS profit FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month FROM t_sales_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND order_date IS NOT NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status <> 'CANCELLED') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month FROM t_purchase_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND order_date IS NOT NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status <> 'CANCELLED') UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(end_time, create_time), '%Y-%m') AS month FROM t_maintenance WHERE status = 'FINISHED' AND COALESCE(end_time, create_time) IS NOT NULL ) months LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS sales_income FROM t_sales_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND order_date IS NOT NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status <> 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') ) s ON months.month = s.month LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS purchase_expense FROM t_purchase_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND order_date IS NOT NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status <> 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') ) p ON months.month = p.month LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(end_time, create_time), '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS maintenance_expense FROM t_maintenance WHERE status = 'FINISHED' AND COALESCE(end_time, create_time) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(end_time, create_time), '%Y-%m') ) m ON months.month = m.month ORDER BY months.month

SELECT CAST(so.customer_id AS CHAR) AS group_key, COALESCE(c.customer_name, CONCAT('Customer-', so.customer_id)) AS group_name, COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM t_sales_order so LEFT JOIN t_customer c ON so.customer_id = c.id WHERE so.is_deleted = 0 AND (so.status IS NULL OR so.status <> 'CANCELLED') AND so.customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY so.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT CAST(m.equipment_id AS CHAR) AS group_key, COALESCE(m.equipment_name, COALESCE(e.equipment_name, CONCAT('Equipment-', m.equipment_id))) AS group_name, COALESCE(SUM(m.cost), 0) AS amount FROM t_maintenance m LEFT JOIN t_equipment e ON m.equipment_id = e.id WHERE m.status = 'FINISHED' AND m.equipment_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.equipment_id, m.equipment_name, e.equipment_name ORDER BY amount DESC
